description: Accessible, themable Vue 3 component library (npm package @surgeui/vue): components, layouts and composables with WAI-ARIA keyboard and screen reader support, light/dark themes, RTL and translatable texts.
rules: Install @surgeui/vue (Vue 3.5+), register the plugin with app.use(SurgeUI) and import @surgeui/vue/style.css once. The former package name @surgeui/ds-vue is deprecated.
Components are registered globally with the Su prefix (<SuButton>, <SuInputField>); named imports drop the prefix (import { Button } from '@surgeui/vue').
Form controls use v-model; use a *Field component (SuInputField, SuSelectBoxField…) or wrap a control in <SuFormField label> for label, message and validation state.
Router links use the `to` prop; icons are Vue components passed to the `icon` prop; icon-only buttons need aria-label.
Toasts: useToast() with <SuToaster /> placed once. Confirmations: useConfirm() with <SuConfirmDialog /> placed once. Announcements: useAnnouncer().
Theme with --su-* CSS custom properties and useTheme() (setTheme, setThemeMode, toggleMode); do not hard-code colors.
Removed in 4.0: useTheme().toggleTheme, setTheme('light'|'dark'), accessibility.trapFocus, accessibility.announceToScreenReader, Dropdown option separator: true, Dialog zIndex prop.
